title: Council on Aging four-year plan
summary: As of September 8, 2026, the office expects to gather and analyze survey data over the next couple of weeks, then work on objectives for the four-year plan. In July, staff said they would reach out to set up a focus group with the disability community and tell council members the schedule once it is set. Back in December 2024, a motion to approve the report and authorize the chair to sign it went unvoted because the council lost its quorum.

timeline.text: In the next couple of weeks, the office will gather and analyze survey data and then work on objectives for the four-year plan.
Council members will be told the focus group schedule once it is set.
Office staff will reach out to set up a focus group with the disability community.
If there is a quorum at the next meeting, the council can discuss and vote on the report.
Motion to approve the report and authorize the chair to sign it: No vote was taken on the motion because the council no longer had a quorum.
